parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is a NestJS DTO that matches the application layer's file pattern **/*.dto.ts. The layer model puts DTOs in the application layer, so this fits that layer's role. It has no persistence, query building, business rules or framework wiring. The @ApiPropertyOptional decorators are Swagger metadata that sits on the DTO. That is standard for NestJS DTOs and does not amount to transport logic, so it is not a misplaced responsibility under this layer model.
